_doc: linux-store declaration. `common` applies to both profiles; `termux` and `desktop` overlay it per key (a profile value of null REMOVES a common entry; activate.render lists are concatenated, common first). Keys starting with _ are documentation. Engine: ./linux-store, semantics in README.md.

settings._doc_git_base: First directory that exists wins; GIT_BASE overrides. The phone keeps its checkouts on the CloudDrive mount, the desktop under ~/git.
settings._doc_roots: Short names for source trees: "claude:agents" = <git base>/cloud-u-linux/da_my-ai/data/claude/agents. The Claude SoT stays where it is; this file only points at it.

common._doc_lib: Shared objects and script libraries. Nothing here is exported globally: a bin entry lists the libs it needs ("libs": [...]) and gets a wrapper with a pinned LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Script libs are reachable at ~/.linux-store/current/lib/<name>.
common._doc_etc: Inert config, mirrored into $HOME as links through `current`. The same set da_my-ai's cmd_assets copies, minus settings.json and ~/.claude.json, which Claude Code rewrites and so belong to activate.
common._doc_activate: Written, not linked. render = deep merge of the listed JSON files (arrays replaced, @HOME@ substituted), laid down whole — the flakes' and cmd_assets' semantics. keys = the .keys object of the named file, set one top-level key at a time into an existing file and never written wholesale.

bin._doc_claude: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 is claude-termux's phone-RAM tuning, carried by the wrapper instead of a hand-kept script.
